metadata.purpose: Assess the next bounded Skinning primitive from legacy ratio/gradient weighting helpers without migrating the legacy graph/skirt monolith.
acceptance: Inspect legacy MayaScriptNew Libs/NLTA_GraphSkinning.py around GradientActiveJoint, CopyRatioWeight, GradientTwoJoints, and their immediate callers.
Inspect current AIMayaTool Skinning APIs to identify overlap and reusable boundaries.
Recommend exactly one next primitive or a tightly coupled minimal pair, with explicit inputs/returns and no dependency on legacy UI/global state.
Report source behavior, proposed AIMayaTool module/API, deterministic-test strategy, Maya-smoke strategy, and any reason not to migrate a candidate.
Do not modify product code during this assessment task.
